description: Use when you need to know which tokens a wallet holds and how much. Ranks by USD value and flags unverified (often spam airdrop) tokens so you do not report fake holdings. Lists a wallet's SPL Token and Token-2022 holdings with exact amounts, verification status and USD value where a price exists. Inputs: wallet: The wallet whose token holdings to read. limit (optional): Maximum tokens to return, highest USD value first. Default 25. includeZero (optional): Include empty token accounts. Default false. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/get_token_accounts.
name: get_token_accounts
